is_anopheles.evidence: Adult mosquitoes collected included Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles funestus s.s. (page 4, Table 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Characterization of kdr (west-African Leu-Phe mutation, Vgsc L995F) and ace-1 (G119S/G280S) mutations was performed (page 3, Molecular analysis; page 5, Table 6 and text).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 6 provides exact genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and sample sizes for the kdr mutation in M and S molecular forms of An. gambiae s.s. across two collection periods (October-December 2007 and January-May 2008), totaling 318 mosquitoes. The text on page 5 also reports Ace-1 genotype data (two RS heterozygotes found in S form).

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquitoes were collected via human landing catches in 28 villages across the Ouidah-Kpomasse-Tori (OKT) district in southern Benin (pages 2-3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article reporting baseline field entomological survey and molecular genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections occurred in 28 specified villages in Ouidah-Kpomasse-Tori (OKT) health district, southern Benin (page 2, page 3 Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Sampling took place during five surveys between October 2007 and May 2008 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Field surveys represent a primary baseline entomological collection conducted before implementing an IRM randomized controlled trial.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and allelic frequencies are provided directly in Table 6 and the main text.

assessment.summary: This study conducted baseline entomological surveys across 28 villages in the Ouidah-Kpomasse-Tori district of southern Benin from October 2007 to May 2008. Field-caught An. gambiae s.s. (M and S molecular forms, now An. coluzzii and An. gambiae) were genotyped for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) and Ace-1 G119S, reporting extractable genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for 318 individuals.
